items.title: QuEra, Harvard and Anthropic Use AI to Reduce Quantum Circuit Resource Requirements
items.excerpt: Researchers from QuEra, Harvard and Anthropic paired Claude with an automated checker that verifies and scores candidate quantum circuits, beating prior designs on gate count and qubits for seven of eight building blocks, including a 12-fold Toffoli reduction for a Reed-Solomon decoder (arXiv 2610.22367).

history_match.title: Anthropic's Claude Designs Leaner Quantum Circuits, Reducing Resources Needed for Key Calculations

items.title: Google Researchers Use AI And Mathematical Proofs to Cut Quantum Computing Requirements
items.excerpt: Google DeepMind and Google Quantum AI used teams of AI agents with Lean-checked proofs to design quantum programs, cutting combined qubit-and-gate costs about 11x for a fusion simulation, 8x for photochemistry and 2.5x for a drug-metabolism model (arXiv 2611.09822).

history_match.title: Google launches $150,000 AI competition to reduce quantum computing demands

items.title: AI-assisted atomic models reveal how protective shells regulate aluminum nanoparticle oxidation
items.excerpt: Tohoku University WPI-AIMR used MLP Copilot, an AI-agent framework, to build machine-learning interatomic potentials from quantum calculations; simulations show oxide shells let oxidation through transient nanoscale pathways at moderate temperatures and rupture at high temperatures (PNAS).

items.title: Researcher uses AI to predict probabilities for chemical processes
items.excerpt: University of Bonn chemist Michael Peintinger had AI agents write most of vibe-qc, an open-source quantum chemistry program for molecules and crystals, under his supervision; cross-checks against an independent code caught errors and confirmed results (Journal of Computational Chemistry).

items.title: Machine learning reveals how often fish schooling evolved—and repeatedly disappeared
items.excerpt: Cornell researchers used a text transformer on species descriptions plus machine learning on iNaturalist photos and videos to score schooling in 2,839 fish species, estimating it evolved independently about 60 times and was lost about 320 times over 350 million years (PNAS).

items.title: AI, computer graphics and wave optics combine for more realistic holographic VR/AR displays
items.excerpt: University of Hong Kong researchers trained a learned optics model on camera measurements to correct imperfections in a holographic display, and paired it with mesh-based hologram generation for smoother focus and sharper detail in lab prototypes (Nature Communications, ACM TOG).

items.title: New AI model could help UN nuclear watchdog achieve near-perfect uranium enrichment assessment
items.excerpt: University of Sharjah researchers trained XGBoost, CatBoost and LightGBM on simulated gamma spectra to estimate U-235 enrichment; all three classified natural, low- and highly-enriched uranium with 100% accuracy on benchmarks, pending real-inspection validation (Annals of Nuclear Energy).

items.title: Preserving human involvement at the start of a creative task can improve AI-assisted outcomes
items.excerpt: Kartik Hosanagar and Daehwan Ahn had 285 students write stories with ChatGPT under three collaboration designs: AI sped writing 36.2%, human-led ideation produced better-rated stories, while merely approving AI drafts produced worse stories than writing unaided (PNAS Nexus).

items.title: Deep-learning framework breakthrough: AI-guided heterogeneous cathode design supercharges lithium-ion batteries
items.excerpt: Huazhong University of Science and Technology and South China Normal University trained a conditional GAN surrogate on ~100,000 physics-model samples and paired it with particle swarm optimization to inverse-design electrode porosity, raising discharge capacity at every rate tested (ENGINEERING Energy).

history_match.title: New materials library could help AI design better sodium-ion batteries

items.title: Prior expertise may determine whether AI builds skills or substitutes for them, field experiment suggests
items.excerpt: A three-month randomized trial with 133 U.S. patent lawyers (MIT's David Autor and Google, NBER working paper) found an AI writing assistant improved drafts most for juniors, but on a later no-AI task only senior lawyers who had used the tool outperformed peers.

items.title: Introducing AlphaProof Code: a breakthrough in verifying complex software at depth
items.excerpt: DeepMind's AlphaProof Code uses multiple LLM agents to write Lean proofs for software verification; it machine-verified the compiled code of Signal's cryptographic protocol in about four weeks, generating over six million lines of Lean and flagging ~1% of the codebase for human review.

items.title: New AI Models Are Turbo-Charging Protein Design
items.excerpt: Computer-designed protein therapeutics are moving from proof-of-concept to wet-lab validation and even clinical trials as new generative AI protein-design models mature.

history_match.title: Nvidia, UW Institute for Protein Design unveil open-source protein design AI model

items.title: Using Vibrations and AI, Future Robotic Missions Could Handle Buried Rocks Autonomously
items.excerpt: Virginia Tech's Erik Komendera combined vibration sensing with AI to estimate how deeply a rock is buried, letting planetary robots clear lunar or Martian terrain more efficiently.
